description_en:
Lightweight Application - Video Splitting\
\
To use video splitting, you must first activate the Media and Entertainment Video Understanding service, which is free. You can activate it at: https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/app/app-market/quanmiao/video-comprehend\
\
Currently, video splitting supports video processing in the following three scenarios:\
1. TV programs\
2. News\
3. Other\
\
For detailed usage recommendations and sample prompts, see the Additional Information section below.\
\
\
\
\
\
\

description_zh:
轻应用-视频拆条

使用视频拆条需先开通影视传媒视频理解（免费开通）https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/app/app-market/quanmiao/video-comprehend

目前拆条提供三种场景视频的处理：
1、节目场景 2、新闻场景 3、其他场景
详细使用建议及参考prompt请查看下方补充说明
kebab_example: aliyun quanmiaolightapp run-video-detect-shot --workspace-id llm-xxxxxxx --video-url https://xxx.mp4 --model-id deepseek-r1 --options ASR --task-id a3d1c2ac-f086-4a21-9069-f5631542f5a2 --original-session-id a3d1c2ac-f086-4a21-9069-f5631542f5ax --prompt xxx --model-custom-prompt-template-id videoDetectShotShowPrompt --model-vl-custom-prompt-template-id videoDetectShotVlShowPrompt --recognition-options ASR --intelli-simp-prompt-template-id intelliSimpShowPrompt --pre-model-id quanmiao-llm-max --intelli-simp-prompt xxx --vl-prompt xxx --biz-language chinese --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunVideoDetectShot

parameters.help_en: Unique identifier of your Alibaba Cloud Model Studio workspace
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云百炼业务空间唯一标识
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
Valid values:

deepseek-r1

quanmiao-llm-max

quanmiao-llm-max-thinking

quanmiao-llm-plus

quanmiao-llm-turbo
parameters.help_zh:
llm的模型，推荐选择deepseek-r1
可选项：
deepseek-r1
quanmiao-llm-max
quanmiao-llm-max-thinking
quanmiao-llm-plus
quanmiao-llm-turbo
parameters.name: model_id

parameters.help_en: Method used for scene detection. Valid value: ASR
parameters.help_zh: 用户选择使用什么方式进行分镜，可选项：ASR
parameters.name: options

parameters.help_en: Unique identifier of the original task. To rerun a subtask based on a previous task, pass in the previous task ID and originalSessionId. The system loads previously generated data and skips earlier steps to improve efficiency. If the stored data is older than seven days, the system reruns all dependent subtasks
parameters.help_zh: 源任务唯一标识：如果要基于历史任务重跑某个子任务（generateOptions字段指定的），可以传入历史任务taskId+originalSessionId，后台会加载历史任务已生成数据，跳过前置步骤，提升生成效率，如果后台数据过久，比如超过7天，查询失败，会默认重跑前置依赖子任务
parameters.name: original_session_id
